claims: The first day of spring 2026 in the USA (Northern Hemisphere) is Friday, March 20, 2026.
The vernal equinox occurs at 10:46 a.m. Eastern Time on Friday, March 20, 2026.
The vernal equinox occurs at 9:46 a.m. Central Time on Friday, March 20, 2026.
The vernal equinox occurs at 8:46 a.m. Mountain Time on Friday, March 20, 2026.
Friday, March 20, 2026 marks equal daylight and darkness.
The spring season lasts until the summer solstice on June 21.
The vernal equinox is when the sun passes directly over the Earth's equator.
